### Requirement: docs/guides/multiplayer-collaboration.md exists and is linked from both...

The system SHALL ensure that docs/guides/multiplayer-collaboration.md exists and is linked from both AGENTS.md and docs/guides/documentation.md.

#### Scenario: docs/guides/multiplayer-collaboration.md exists and is linked from both...

WHEN `multiplayer-principles-guide` is implemented
THEN docs/guides/multiplayer-collaboration.md exists and is linked from both AGENTS.md and docs/guides/documentation.md.

### Requirement: Each of the ten principles names at least one capability or existing...

The system SHALL ensure that each of the ten principles names at least one capability or existing mechanism that implements it.

#### Scenario: Each of the ten principles names at least one capability or existing...

WHEN `multiplayer-principles-guide` is implemented
THEN Each of the ten principles names at least one capability or existing mechanism that implements it.

### Requirement: The guide contains the single-principal assumption table and a per-skill...

The system SHALL ensure that the guide contains the single-principal assumption table and a per-skill solo-mode versus team-mode behavior section stating that solo mode adds no new prompts, gates, or PR checkpoints.

#### Scenario: The guide contains the single-principal assumption table and a per-skill...

WHEN `multiplayer-principles-guide` is implemented
THEN The guide contains the single-principal assumption table and a per-skill solo-mode versus team-mode behavior section stating that solo mode adds no new prompts, gates, or PR checkpoints.
